title: PSN Down Sporadically for Some as GTA 6 Launches Around the World
summary: Squeaky bum time. GTA 6 is a single player game , but Sony’s servers are taking a hammering as the game goes online around the world. While you can’t play Rockstar’s latest with other people, you will need to verify your digital license once the title is available in your region – a timely reminder of the digital era we’re all now living in.
